spaces.name: Basalt Gate forecourt
spaces.note: Torii of single basalt columns at A4, facing east toward the hall door.

spaces.name: Arrival hall (lava window)
spaces.note: Carved into the mountain foot; south facade is timber under the cliff. Lava window on the north wall x 44-78. Spiral/lift core in the NE corner.

spaces.name: South terrace
spaces.note: Front of the halls; cable lift base at E5; steps down to the B5 pools.

spaces.name: Cascade Terrace pools (lower)
spaces.note: Lowest terraces, -0.5 to -4 m, stepping down south; drains north into the mountain to B1.

spaces.name: East cliff terrace
spaces.note: Ledge on the east cliff outside the changing halls; the sea-cliff path leads north from it to the Cliff Stair foot.

spaces.name: Sea-cliff path round the NE shoulder
spaces.note: Cliff-top path along the east edge from the east terrace to the foot of the north cliff.

spaces.name: North cliff foot ledge
spaces.note: Foot of the north cliff below the suites; sea cliff beyond.

spaces.name: B1 lift lobby
spaces.note: Ring round the spiral well, clipped to keep rock between it and the Mirror dome.

spaces.name: Mist corridor to the Mirror
spaces.note: Compressed passage (4 m wide, 3 m high) before the Mirror reveal.

spaces.name: 05 Obsidian Mirror Float Pool
spaces.note: Dome with glowworm ceiling. Shaped around the lift core: pool centre moved to F2 (logged).

spaces.name: 06 Fumarole Steam Grotto
spaces.note: Rooms 45/55/65 C, hotter as you go deeper (NW).

spaces.name: Magma Glass Slide launch / Lava Stair head
Outfall to the river (J2)
spaces.note: Corridor water spills down a shaft at J2 to the B2 river head.

spaces.name: Kawagiri restaurant
spaces.note: Spine deck on beams along y 84 over the widened river; 6 pods each side over the water.

spaces.name: Boardwalk river edge (open to the river)
spaces.note: Opens the rock between the boardwalk and the river so you walk beside the water behind a railing (B2 agent review).

spaces.name: Underground river channel
spaces.note: Void of the river from the J2 inflow to the falls lip; floor is the river bed. Footprint = w_river footprint.

spaces.name: Aqua Cavern vault (envelope)
spaces.note: The one great vault over rimstone, lazy river, geyser plaza and slide foot (roof -50, domed). Sub-spaces sit inside it; the lazy river tube is an asset, not shell.

spaces.name: 09 Thunder Curtain Falls basin
spaces.note: Tall shaft under the river lip. Pool -60.0, curtain from the lip at -43.

spaces.name: 08 Rimstone Cascade Terraces
spaces.note: Terraces step -60.5 (NW) to -66.5 (SE).

spaces.name: 02 Lava Tube Lazy River
spaces.note: Loop channel 6 m wide in a low lava tube (roof -63.5); island inside is the Geyser Plaza.

spaces.name: Shore path
spaces.note: Low compressed passage (4.5 m) before the beach reveal.

spaces.name: 10 Wave Grotto beach
spaces.note: Black sand beach slopes -67.5 to -70.6; sea mouth on the east edge.

spaces.name: Falls shaft (east, open to B2)
spaces.note: The east part of the falls shaft rises to -32 so the B2 falls-head balcony overlooks the curtain (B2 agent review).

spaces.name: Gallery behind the curtain
spaces.note: Carved walkway behind Thunder Curtain at -55, under the river (bed -44.6, 7 m of rock above the gallery roof).

spaces.name: Magma viewing chamber
spaces.note: Hush zone. Thick glass wall along y 8 with lava beyond.

spaces.name: Rim walk
spaces.note: Keeps off the south infinity edge and the moon deck (option A, ground/summit agent).
